name: MonarchCalloutBanner
title: CalloutBanner
wrapsNative: Text, Button, RoundedRectangle, Rectangle; safeAreaInset(edge: .top) for the page placement
summary: A banner for a screen or a section, with a tone, an optional title, one action and a dismiss button; also a compact notice that the view is narrowed.
whenToUse: For trials, maintenance and billing notices across the top of a screen, for a callout inside the content that can be dismissed, and for saying that a list is filtered.
whenNotToUse: For a plain status beside the content it is about, use MonarchBanner. For one line attached to a field or row, use MonarchInlineNotice. For a message that must interrupt, use the system alert modifier.
api: init(_ title: String? = nil, message: String, systemImage: String? = nil, tone: MonarchTone = .info, variant: MonarchCalloutBannerVariant = .callout, placement: MonarchCalloutBannerPlacement = .section, toneLabel: String? = nil, actionTitle: String? = nil, actionVariant: MonarchButtonVariant = .secondary, dismissLabel: String? = nil, action: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onDismiss: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil)

options.name: title
options.description: A short title on the first line.

options.name: systemImage
options.description: Replaces the SF Symbol of the tone.

options.name: tone
options.description: Selects the colours and the icon. Ignored by the scope variant.

options.name: variant
options.description: callout, or scope: a compact neutral notice that the view is narrowed.

options.name: placement
options.description: section is rounded and bordered; page is a full-width strip with a line below.

options.name: toneLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in spoken name of the tone.

options.name: actionTitle
options.description: Title of the action button. No button without it.

options.name: action
options.description: Runs when the action button is activated.

options.name: onDismiss
options.description: Runs when the dismiss button is activated. No dismiss button without it.

options.name: actionVariant
options.description: How the action button is drawn.

states.name: dismissible
states.description: A close button at the trailing edge, when onDismiss is given. The app removes the banner.

appearance: A container with the subtle fill and the border of its tone, the icon in the strong colour of the tone and text in the default text colour. The neutral tone and the scope variant use the subtle background and the default border. The page placement has square corners and only a line along its lower edge.
platformNotes: The banner does not hide itself: the web keeps its own open state when uncontrolled, here the app removes the view in onDismiss. One action instead of the web's actions slot, placed under the text (the scope variant puts it at the trailing edge when it fits); there is no actionPlacement option. No accent tone, because MonarchTone has none. The landmark and live options have no equivalent: post an announcement when you insert a banner. Monarch does not install the banner in the safe area; the app does, with safeAreaInset(edge: .top). Android builds the same component. Several closures are optional (action, onDismiss). Pass each one with its label: Swift gives a single unlabelled trailing closure to the first parameter that accepts it, which is action.
accessibility: The icon, title and message are one element, read as the tone name, the title, then the message.
The tone name is spoken, so the tone does not depend on colour or the icon; toneLabel replaces it. The neutral tone and the scope variant have no spoken tone.
The action and the dismiss button are separate buttons with touch targets of at least 44 points.
The dismiss button is named "Dismiss"; dismissLabel replaces the name.
The banner does not announce itself when it appears.
edgeCases: actionTitle without action, or action without actionTitle, shows no action button.
In the scope variant the action moves under the text when both do not fit on one line.
The dismiss button's touch target reaches 12 points into the banner's padding so that the glyph lines up with the content.

examples.title: Page banner with an action
examples.template:
MonarchCalloutBanner(
    {{title}},
    message: {{body}},
    tone: {{tone|tone}},
    placement: .{{placement|raw}},
    actionTitle: {{action.label}},
    actionVariant: {{action.variant|case}},
    action: {},
    onDismiss: {}
)
examples.code:
MonarchCalloutBanner(
    "Your trial ends in 3 days",
    message: "Add a payment method to keep your workspace and its data.",
    tone: .accent,
    placement: .page,
    actionTitle: "Choose a plan",
    actionVariant: .primary,
    action: {},
    onDismiss: {}
)

examples.title: A notice that the view is narrowed

parityExceptions.reason: The banner action is always the sm button, which is the web's size for this example; the size is not a parameter.
parityExceptions.convention: none: the drawn size is the web's
